# MyWorld Social Media Application - Development Guide

## Project Overview
Full-stack social media application similar to Facebook with React frontend, Node.js backend, and PostgreSQL database.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Create project structure (.github directory)
- [ ] Initialize React frontend with Vite
- [ ] Initialize Node.js backend with Express
- [ ] Create database schema and migrations
- [ ] Set up authentication (JWT)
- [ ] Create API endpoints
- [ ] Build React components for social features
- [ ] Configure environment variables
- [ ] Test backend and frontend integration
- [ ] Create documentation

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18+, Vite, React Router, Axios, CSS/Tailwind
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, JWT, PostgreSQL
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with proper schema design
- **Tools**: npm, git

## Key Features to Implement
1. User authentication and profiles
2. Post creation and feed display
3. Comments on posts
4. Like functionality
5. Friend/connection system
6. Real-time updates (future enhancement)

## Project Structure
```
MyWorld/
├── frontend/          # React application
├── backend/           # Node.js Express server
├── database/          # PostgreSQL schemas and migrations
└── README.md
```
